name: Wanderer Deeds
body:
The following are the deeds a wanderer can learn. A deed can only be acquired once, unless otherwise stated. The deeds have prerequisites listed if they are applicable.

Antagonize (Ex)

So long as you have 1 grit point remaining, you antagonize a foe. Whenever you successfully demoralize a foe using Intimidate, they remain shaken against every other foe than you for 1 minute or until they successfully hit you with an attack or negatively affect you with a spell. This cannot cause their fear condition to increase above shaken.

Assured Derring-Do (Ex)

Prerequisite: Derring-do

While you have at least 1 grit point, you can take 10 on any Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Fly, Ride, or Swim check, even while distracted or in immediate danger. You can use this ability in conjunction with the derring-do deed.

Blank Slate (Su)

Prerequisite: 15th level

While you have at least 1 grit point remaining, you are treated as though under the effects of nondetection and you gain the benefits of the slippery mind rogue talent.

Bleeding Wound (Ex)

Prerequisite: 11th level

On a successful hit, you can expend a grit point to deal extra bleed damage. The amount of bleed is equal to your Dexterity or Strength modifier, whichever is applied to your attack rolls. Alternatively, you can spend 2 grit points to deal 1 point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution bleed damage (your choice) instead. Creatures immune to precision damage are immune to this deed.

Cheat Death (Ex)

Prerequisite: 17th level

Whenever you would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you can spend all of your grit points (minimum 1) to instead be reduced to 1 hit point.

Close and Personal (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

If someone passes through or out of your threatened area, you can expend 1 grit point to move up to your speed to follow the target instead of making an attack of opportunity. If you end up adjacent to the target after the movement, you may then make your attack of opportunity against the target. You must have an attack of opportunity available to use this deed. The movement from this deed is deducted from your movement on your next turn.

Dodging Dance (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You move around your opponents’ attacks to open them up for strikes. You can spend 1 grit point to move up to half your speed as a move action. If a creature makes an attack of opportunity against you due to this movement, you can attempt an Acrobatics check with a DC equal to the attacking creature’s CMD. If you succeed, the attack of opportunity misses, and you can make an attack of opportunity against the attacking creature instead. You can attempt to evade multiple attacks of opportunity during this movement, but the DC of the Acrobatics check increases by 2 for each additional opponent that makes an attack of opportunity against you during this movement. If you have an ability that grants her additional attacks of opportunity, you can use them to respond to multiple missed attacks of opportunity with your own attacks.

Deadeye (Ex)

You can resolve an attack against touch AC instead of normal AC when firing beyond your firearm’s first range increment. Performing this deed costs 1 grit point per range increment beyond the first. You still take the –2 penalty on attack rolls for each range increment beyond the first when you perform this deed.

Deadly Attack (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

You can expend a grit point as a full-round action to make one single attack. You roll all the attacks as if you had made a full attack, except for each hit, you add a dice worth of damage to your normal damage as if using Vital Strike. For example, a 7th level wanderer with a longsword would roll 2d8 + their bonuses if both of their attack rolls hit. If one or more hits are critical hits, they are confirmed at your highest base attack bonus – 5.

For each critical threat beyond the first, you reduce this penalty by 1 (to a maximum of 0). Those critical hits add an extra die of damage for each critical multiplier – 1 to the damage dice pool. So a x3 multiplier would add 2 additional damage dice.

Derring-Do (Ex)

You can spend 1 grit point when making an Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Fly, Ride, or Swim check to roll 1d6 and add the result to the check. You can do this after you make the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, you roll another 1d6 and add it to the check. You can continue to do this as long as you roll natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum 1).

Distracting Attack (Ex)

Prerequisite: 9th level

If you hit a target with an attack that expends at least 1 point of grit, the target is flat footed against the next attack you make before the end of your next turn.

Distracting Miss (Ex)

As a standard action, you can expend a grit point and purposefully miss a target with an attack to render them flat-footed until the start of your next turn. You must have been able to attack the creature to affect them.

Don’t You Die on Me (Ex)

Prerequisite: 17th level

You can beat life back into a recently killed ally. You can spend at least 2 grit points to create the effects of the breath of life spell on a target. For every round after the 1st they have been dead, you must expend an additional grit point to revive them with this effect (and bypassing the duration limit of the underlying spell). This is not a magical effect but a function of you forcing alcohol down their throat, hitting them really hard over the heart, or maybe even moving them with solemn words or a single tear. Regardless, the target must be bodily intact as per the spell to be affected.

Evasive (Ex)

Prerequisite: 5th level

When you have at least 1 grit point, you gain the benefits of evasion. If you reach 11th level, this becomes improved evasion. If you already have evasion from another source, those levels stack for determining if you gain improved evasion from this deed.

Expert Loading (Ex)

Whenever you roll a misfire with a gun that has the broken condition, you can spend 1 grit point to keep the gun from exploding, though it retains the broken condition.

Fluid Maneuvers (Ex)

So long as you have 1 grit point remaining, you may make any combat maneuver check that uses Strength using your Dexterity instead.

Hardened Glare (Ex)

Your hard stare can make even the deadliest enemy rethink their words and actions. If a creature attempts a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check against you or an ally within 30 feet, as an immediate action you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize. If the Intimidate check exceeds the result of the enemy’s skill check, their check automatically fails. If you exceed it by 5 or more, they are shaken for 1 round in addition to the check failing. This is a mind-affecting effect, and the enemy must be able to see you to be affected.

Killing Blow (Ex)

Prerequisite: 19th level

When you score a critical hit, you can spend 2 grit points to deal normal damage and force the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your wanderer level + the ability score modifier used for your attack roll). On a failed save, the target dies. This is a death effect. This deed does not recover grit from the critical hit or the killing blow, if applicable. This deed cannot have its cost reduced by an ability or feat.

Kip-Up (Ex)

While you have at least 1 grit point, you can stand up from prone as a move action without provoking an attack of opportunity. You can kip-up as a swift action instead by spending 1 grit point.

Lucky Dodge (Ex)

You have an uncanny knack for getting out of the way of ranged attacks. When a melee or ranged attack is made against you, you can spend 1 grit point to move 5 feet as an immediate action; doing so grants you a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. This movement is not a 5-foot step, and provokes attacks of opportunity.

Alternatively, you can drop prone to gain a +4 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. You can only perform this deed while wearing medium or light armor, and while carrying no more than a light load.

Menacing Attack (Ex)

While you have at least 1 grit point, when you hit an opponent with an attack, you can choose to use Intimidate to demoralize that opponent as a swift action instead of a standard action.

Menacing Finish (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Menacing attack.

While you have at least 1 grit point, if you reduce a target to 0 hit points of fewer with an attack, you may make a free Intimidate check to demoralize all enemies within 30 feet. The target dropped to 0 or fewer hit points must have HD of at least your character level -3.

Opportune Maneuver (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Opportune parry and riposte.

When using opportune parry and riposte or any of the abilities that use it as a prerequisite, you use your riposte to perform a combat maneuver, without provoking an attack of opportunity, in place of the attack.

Opportune Parry and Riposte (Ex)

When an opponent makes a melee attack against you, you can spend 1 grit point and expend a use of an attack of opportunity to attempt to parry that attack.

If you have any penalty to your attack from Combat Expertise or fighting defensively, they do not apply to the parrying attack, but they still apply to the repost.

You make an attack roll as if you were making an attack of opportunity, even if you are wielding a weapon for which you cannot perform an attack of opportunity.

For each size category the attacking creature is larger than you, you take a –2 penalty on this roll. If your result is greater than the attacking creature’s result, the creature’s attack automatically misses. You must declare the use of this ability after the creature’s attack is announced, but before its attack roll is made. Upon performing a successful parry and if you have at least 1 grit point, you can as an immediate action make an attack against the creature whose attack you parried, provided that creature is within your reach or if the parried attack was a melee natural attack, or within the first range increment of your ranged weapon. If using a ranged weapon, you cannot riposte against a creature that could, in normal circumstances, get an attack of opportunity against you unless you have a bayonet-like weapon attachment. This deed’s cost cannot be reduced by any ability or effect that reduces the number of grit points a deed costs.

Opportune Reload (Ex)

Prerequisite: 9th level

When you are expending grit to attack with a ranged weapon that requires reloading, you can reload the weapon as a free action. This includes when the grit expenditure is on an attack of opportunity or with the opportune parry and riposte deed.

Peacekeeper (Ex)

When you have at least 1 grit point remaining, you do not take any penalty for using a lethal weapon to deliver nonlethal damage. Additionally, if used in conjunction with the precise strike deed, you double the precision damage dealt if you choose to deal nonlethal damage.

Peacekeeper’s Maneuver (Ex)

Prerequisite: Peace Keeper

So long as you have 1 grit point remaining, when you succeed on a bull rush, disarm, or trip combat maneuver, you also deal nonlethal damage equal to the typical melee weapon damage of the weapon you are wielding.

If the weapon is ranged, it deals 1d4 (medium) nonlethal bludgeoning damage.

Penetrating Attack (Ex)

Prerequisite: 9th level

When wielding a ranged weapon or a reach weapon, as a standard action you can spend 1 grit point to attack two creatures in a straight line away from you. You make one attack and resolve against both of their ACs and roll damage once. The damage is dealt normally against the first target and halved against the second. However, if you miss the first target and hit the second, you instead deal full damage to the second target.

Precise Strike (Ex)

When you have at least 1 grit point remaining, you can add 1/2 your wanderer level (minimum +1) to damage dealt. This damage is precision damage and is not doubled on a critical hit. You can also spend a grit point to double this damage on the next attack made before the beginning of your next turn. If the damage bonus is not applied, it is lost. This deed’s cost cannot be reduced by any ability or effect that reduces the number of grit points a deed costs.

Quick Clear (Ex)

As a standard action, you can remove the broken condition from a single firearm you are currently wielding, as long as that condition was gained by a firearm misfire. You must have at least 1 grit point to perform this deed. Alternatively, if you spend 1 grit point to perform this deed, you can perform quick clear as a move-equivalent action instead of a standard action.

Resolve (Ex)

Prerequisite: 5th level

When you have at least 1 grit point, when rolling a Fortitude or Will save, you may spend a grit point to roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. This deed may be used after the initial saving throw is made but before the results of the saving throw are revealed.

Return the Favor (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Opportune parry and riposte.

You can use your opportune parry and riposte on attacks against allies. The allies must be within your melee attack range to be protected.

Running Reload (Ex)

So long as you have 1 grit point remaining, you can reload your weapon while making a move action.

Shrug it Off (Ex)

Prerequisite: 9th level

You can spend 2 grit points to negate some of your most grievous wounds. After a critical hit is confirmed against you, you can spend the grit as an immediate action to treat that critical hit as a normal hit. Effects that only trigger on a critical hit do not trigger when you use this deed. This deed’s cost cannot be reduced by any ability or effect that reduces the number of grit points a deed costs.

Stepping Parry and Riposte (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Opportune parry and riposte.

When using opportune parry and riposte or any of the abilities that use it as a prerequisite, you can move up to half your speed before or after parrying or riposting.

This movement is counted against your movement the next round. A 5-foot step for this ability is considered a 5-foot step and takes your ability to make a 5-foot step the following round.

Strikeback (Ex)

When wielding a ranged weapon or a reach weapon, you can expend a grit point to strike an adjacent creature with a blunt end or portion of the weapon. This weapon deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage for a Medium creature and has a critical of 20/x2. The strike gains the enhancement bonus and other attack bonuses from your feats or abilities with the underlying weapon.

This ability cannot be used to grant you attacks of opportunity. If the attack hits, you gain a trip attempt to knock the target prone as a free action.

Stunning Strike (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

When you hit a creature, you can spend 3 grit points to stun the creature for 1 round. The creature must make a Fortitude saving throw (the DC = 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Dexterity or Strength modifier, whichever is used for the attack). If the creature fails, it is stunned for 1 round. Creatures that are immune to critical hits are also immune to this effect.

Subtle Blade (Ex)

While you have at least 1 grit point, you are immune to disarm, steal, and sunder combat maneuvers made against equipment you are wearing or holding.

Sure Footing (Ex)

While you have at least 1 grit point, you can use a swift action to ignore magical and natural difficult terrain for the rest of your turn.

Take Advantage of Fear (Ex)

Prerequisite: 9th level

While you have at least 1 grit point, you treat any creature that is shaken, frightened, or panicked as flatfooted against your attacks.

Targeting Strike (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

As a full-round action you can expend a grit point to target a specific body location with your attack. You must be able to attack the target to use this deed on them. If the target does not have one of the listed body locations, that location cannot be targeted. Creatures immune to precision damage are immune to this deed.

Arms: On a hit, the target takes half damage and is subject to an immediate disarm attempt using your attack roll for the combat maneuver check. This disarm attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Any bonuses you have to disarm apply to this attempt.
Head: On a hit, the target is damaged normally and is confused for 1 round. This is a mindaffecting effect.
Legs: On a hit, the target is damaged normally and is subject to an immediate trip attempt using your attack roll for the combat maneuver check. This trip attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Any bonuses you have to trip combat maneuvers apply on this attempt.
Torso: The critical threat range of the attack 9 is increased by 2 after any other critical threat modifications are applied.
Wings: On a hit, the target takes half damage and must make a fly check against a DC equal to your attack roll or fall 20 feet. This does not affect wingless creatures.
Unbounded Wanderer (Ex)

While you have at least 1 panache point, you take no penalty for moving at full speed when you use Acrobatics to attempt to move through a threatened area or an enemy’s space.

Unstoppable (Ex)

Prerequisite: 7th level

If you are reduced to fewer than 0 hit points, you can expend a grit point to automatically stabilize and remain conscious. You can continue to act during the round, though you are staggered. You must expend a grit point each round you are below 0 hit points at the beginning of your turn to remain conscious and staggered. This deed cannot be used if you are killed. This deed’s cost cannot be reduced by any ability or effect that reduces the number of grit points a deed costs.

Wanderer’s Determination (Ex)

As a standard action, you can spend 1 grit point to remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition. If you are at least 8th level, you can spend 2 grit points to remove the exhausted, frightened, nauseated, or staggered conditions. If the condition has a duration longer than 1 hour or is permanent, this ability removes the condition for 1 hour, at which time the condition returns.

Wanderer’s Luck (Ex)

Prerequisite: 15th level

As a free action, usable outside of your turn, to reroll a saving throw by spending 2 grit points or a skill check by expending 1 grit point. You must take the result of the second roll even if it is lower. This deed’s cost cannot be reduced by the true grit class feature or any other feat or ability that reduces deed costs.

Wanderer’s Sense (Ex)

Prerequisite: 3rd level

While you have at least 1 grit point remaining, you gain the benefits of the Blind-Fight feat. Once you reach 7th level, you gain blindsense out to 5 feet when you have 1 grit point remaining. At 13th level, this increases to 10 feet, and 15 feet at 17th level.

Wanderer’s Stride (Ex)

Prerequisite: 3rd level

While you have at least 1 grit point remaining, you gain the benefit of the woodland stride and trackless step abilities of the ranger.

Wandering Outlaw (Ex)

You gain Sleight of Hand as a class skill and when rolling Bluff or Sleight of Hand you can roll a 1d6 and add the result to the check. You can do this after you make the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, you roll another 1d6 and add it to the check. You can continue to do this as long as you roll natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Additionally, if you later gain the opportune parry and riposte deed (and deeds that have it as a prerequisite) you can use those deeds with a concealed weapon you do not currently have equipped.

Wandering Peacekeeper (Ex)

You gain Diplomacy as a class skill, and when rolling Diplomacy you can roll a 1d6 and add the result to the check. You can do this after you make the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is 10 a natural 6, you roll another 1d6 and add it to the check.

You can continue to do this as long as you roll natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). You can also use Diplomacy in place of Intimidate for any deeds that use Intimidate or to demoralize. Additionally, if you later gain the opportune parry and riposte deed (and deeds that have it as a prerequisite) you can use those deeds to perform a bull rush, disarm, grapple, or trip combat maneuver instead of the attack as the riposte.

Weapon Twirl (Ex)

Prerequisite: Bluff 3 ranks

So long as you have 1 grit point remaining, you may make a feint attempt with a ranged attack against a target within your first range increment of the weapon used.
